package demo;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
public final class C16 extends BComponent {
  private Clock.Ticket a;
  private Clock.Ticket b;
  public void arm() { a = Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.makeSeconds(5), x, null); b = Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.makeSeconds(9), y, null); }
  public void stopped() throws Exception { super.stopped(); if (stopTimer(a)) { } if (stopTimer(b)) { } }
  private static boolean stopTimer(Clock.Ticket t) { if (t == null) return false; t.cancel(); return true; }
}
